S.FORM: sua iiku ia, tee=ku pu-a-iisua si-pu-ʔəcipi ʔənnaŋ.
S.PHON: sua iiku ia teeku puaiisua ʂipuʔətʂipi ʔənnaŋ
S.FORM: sua iiku ia, teeku puaiisua sipu'ecipi 'ennang.
S.PHON: sua iiku ia teeku puaiisua ʂipuʔetʂipi ʔennaŋ
S.TRANSL: I will talk about how to cook the fruit of the bird lime plant.

S.FORM: caniaava nu naatia=ci carəʔ-ən ia, apacuaʔ-ai ʔuuna=kara maʔain, sa ʔakia=kara maʔain.
S.PHON: ʦaniaava nu naatiatʂi ʦarəʔən ia apaʦuaʔai ʔuunakara maʔain sa ʔakiakara maʔain
S.FORM: caniaava nu naatiaci care'en ia, apacua'ai 'uunakara ma'ain, sa 'akiakara ma'ain.
S.PHON: ʦaniaava nu naatiatʂi ʦa[r|ɾ]eʔen ia apaʦuaʔai ʔuunaka[r|ɾ]a maʔain sa ʔakiaka[r|ɾ]a maʔain
S.TRANSL: For example, if you want to sprinkle salt on it, you may or may not have salt.

S.FORM: c<əm>əʔəra=ku maʔain=maku ia, u-cani=cu maamia ipuc-a.
S.PHON: ʦəməʔəraku maʔainmaku ia uʦaniʦu maamia ipuʦa
S.FORM: c<em>e'eraku ma'ainmaku ia, ucanicu maamia ipuca.
S.PHON: ʦemeʔe[r|ɾ]aku maʔainmaku ia uʦaniʦu maamia ipuʦa
S.TRANSL: When I checked my salt, there was only one wrapped pack.

S.FORM: tee=kara=ʔai mustampə, sa kaʔan=kara, aapacuaʔ-ai nuu kaa-i mustampə ia, ma-kai-naanu.
S.PHON: teekaraʔai mustampə sa kaʔankara aapaʦuaʔai nuu kaai mustampə ia makainaanu
S.FORM: teekara'ai mustampe, sa ka'ankara, aapacua'ai nuu kaai mustampe ia, makainaanu.
S.PHON: teeka[r|ɾ]aʔai mustampe sa kaʔanka[r|ɾ]a aapaʦuaʔai nuu kaai mustampe ia makainaanu
S.TRANSL: That might or might not be enough. Even if it is not enough, it does not matter.
When we are to eat (fruit of the bird lime plant), we should stir and fry it.

S.FORM: nu iisua ia, taavalaʔ-ən pa-sa-tiʔiŋ=pa maʔain, manasi saa-ʔuʔu.
S.PHON: nu iisua ia taavaɾaʔən pasatiʔiŋpa maʔain manaʂi saaʔuʔu
S.FORM: nu iisua ia, taavara'en pasati'ingpa ma'ain, manasi saa'u'u.
S.PHON: nu iisua ia taava[r|ɾ]aʔen pasatiʔiŋpa maʔain manaʂi saaʔuʔu
S.TRANSL: Then we can add a little salt to make it delicious.

S.FORM: nakai ʔuuna=pa maʔain, maka-ŋəəcə pa-sa-tiʔiŋ-in=pa c<um>arəʔə.
S.PHON: nakai ʔuunapa maʔain makaŋəəʦə pasatiʔiŋinpa ʦumarəʔə
nakai ʔuunapa maʔain makaŋeeʦe pasatiʔiŋinpa ʦuma[r|ɾ]eʔe
S.TRANSL: If there is some salt, we can finally sprinkle a little on them.
